messages.subject: Heads of Terms (subject to contract)
messages.plaintextBody:
Liam,

Attached are the draft heads of terms reflecting where we landed on the call: 3-year initial term, £120k implementation, £840k year-one subscription with a 5% annual uplift, 99.9% availability with service credits, and a 45-day exclusivity period. Liability cap is flagged as to-be-negotiated — we will propose 100% of annual charges with a data/confidentiality super-cap once we are in the contract.

If you are happy, we will send to Catherine Vane at Pennine.

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100
